name: novelgraph
description: Local fiction production through an inspectable story graph

scripts.build: corepack pnpm --filter @actalk/novelgraph-core build && corepack pnpm --filter @actalk/novelgraph-studio build && corepack pnpm --filter @actalk/novelgraph build && corepack pnpm --filter @actalk/novelgraph-site build
scripts.test: corepack pnpm --filter @actalk/novelgraph-core test && corepack pnpm --filter @actalk/novelgraph-studio test && corepack pnpm --filter @actalk/novelgraph test
scripts.lint: corepack pnpm typecheck && corepack pnpm copy:lint && corepack pnpm docs:check && corepack pnpm diagrams:check
scripts.typecheck: corepack pnpm --filter @actalk/novelgraph-core typecheck && corepack pnpm --filter @actalk/novelgraph-studio typecheck && corepack pnpm --filter @actalk/novelgraph typecheck
scripts.release: corepack pnpm build && corepack pnpm test
